name: exa
description: Neural embeddings-based semantic web search and deep research engine designed specifically for autonomous AI agents.

capabilities.description: Perform neural or keyword search across the web using natural language intent.
Discover web pages semantically related to a given URL.
Extract clean markdown text and highlights from specific web page URLs.
Perform neural search and extract full page contents and summaries in one step.
Search scientific papers, preprints, and research documentation with peer-reviewed source filtering.
